prompt: Build a reversible (no measurement, no classical bits) 4-qubit half-adder circuit using CNOT and Toffoli (CCX) gates. Qubits 0 and 1 are the inputs a and b; qubits 2 and 3 are fresh ancilla outputs, both starting at |0>, that must end up holding sum = a XOR b (qubit 2) and carry = a AND b (qubit 3). IMPORTANT constraint: compute each output using ONLY qubits 0 and 1 (the original inputs) as controls. Do not use qubit 2 or qubit 3 as a control for computing the other output, and do not let one output's gates depend on the other output's qubit in any way.
